memory.cpu_max_rss_scope: process lifetime high-water RSS; not accelerator peak

limitations: Clean-at-run is recorded by trainer, not independently observable retrospective Git status. Committed source blobs and current bytes checked.
No weights loaded or hashed; initialization/weight changes rely on pinned trainer source and run metadata, not independent tensor verification.

Inference receipts bind checkpoint paths, not weight byte hashes. Fresh subprocess implementation, invocation/exit/log/output evidence supports actual reload; not external process attestation or hermetic sandbox.
Checkpoint embedded run.status remains running; completed standalone run.json and later process receipts supersede that snapshot.
At most one invocation per architecture supported by supplied artifacts, not exhaustive machine-wide execution history.
